title: Reuse kith-tui and crate-jmap for JMAP layers
description: Reuse Mark's existing code instead of writing JMAP from scratch: (1) TUI (.29) adapts ~/PROJECT/kith/crates/kith-tui (ratatui, ~3.9k lines, AGPL-3.0-or-later, light coupling to kith-core JmapRequest/parse_sse_frame/StateChange), swapping its transport to crate-jmap jmap-chat-client if clean. (2) Provider JMAP Chat (.11) and agent inward plaintext side (.13) build on ~/PROJECT/crate-jmap jmap-chat-server + jmap-chat-types (0.1.2, MIT OR Apache-2.0); agent supplies an MLS-backed backend. (3) Agent outward connection uses jmap-chat-client. ~/PROJECT/nie (openmls 0.8, daemon+tui, own relay protocol) is reference only for .4. Each reuse starts with a diff vs current draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00; deltas become decisions per the spec-ambiguity rule.
